name: word-corners
description: Mobile-friendly word game. The game itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies — wrangler is here only to run and deploy the Cloudflare Worker + D1 backend.

scripts.db:games: wrangler d1 execute word-corners-staging --env staging --remote --command="SELECT * FROM games ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:games:production: wrangler d1 execute word-corners --remote --command="SELECT * FROM games ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:objectives: wrangler d1 execute word-corners-staging --env staging --remote --command="SELECT type, params, cost, COUNT(*) AS dealt, SUM(completed) AS completed, ROUND(AVG(completed) * 100, 1) AS pct FROM game_objectives GROUP BY type, params ORDER BY pct"
scripts.db:objectives:production: wrangler d1 execute word-corners --remote --command="SELECT type, params, cost, COUNT(*) AS dealt, SUM(completed) AS completed, ROUND(AVG(completed) * 100, 1) AS pct FROM game_objectives GROUP BY type, params ORDER BY pct"
